firm_data.firm_description: Scahill Law Group P.C. is a leading New York Litigation Law Firm dedicated to serving commercial insurers and self-insured corporations. They have grown to a staff of over 100 professionals, including more than 40 lawyers.
notable_facts: The firm was founded in 1991 by Frank Scahill and John F. Picciano.
The firm has experience conducting fraud investigations and handling complex insurance coverage issues.
Scahill Law Group P.C. offers pro bono legal services to the U.S. Marine Garrison in Garden City and the U.S. Army Garrison at Fort Hamilton.
technology_signals: The firm uses a custom-built case management system.
Attorneys leverage the latest online tools.

founders.name: John F. Picciano
founders.title: Former FBI agent and Founding Partner
